The most compelling evidence for a turnaround narrative is the massive improvement in the annual operating margin, which surged by 1647 percentage points from -1700% three years ago to -53% in March 2026 [E23]. This trajectory demonstrates a significant operational pivot that is not yet fully reflected in the company's current valuation metrics. Furthermore, the company maintains an ROA of 1.39%, which is remarkably close to the sector benchmark of 1.55%, suggesting that the underlying asset base is already performing near industry standards despite the broader financial volatility [E7]. Conceded: the P/B ratio of 1430.00x, the negative ROE of -5.7%, and the extreme EV/EBITDA of 990.04x indicate that the market is currently pricing in substantial risk and high expectations [E1, E8, E10]. While the quarterly operating margin declined by 377 percentage points year-over-year, the long-term trend of margin recovery remains the primary indicator of the company's evolving efficiency [E23, E24]. Investors focusing solely on the high valuation multiples may be overlooking the structural progress being made in the company's core operations [E59].
